verdict.rationale: Phaser Studio ships an official MCP-based 'Game Agent' server with 40+ specialized tools that lets AI coding agents (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Copilot) drive the Scene Editor — create/edit scenes, objects, particle emitters, layers, filters, and trigger builds/publishing via natural language — which matches the story's ask for a documented scriptable interface for agent-driven editing. However, evidence lacks a formal API/schema reference (no OpenAPI spec, no npm-published MCP package, docs-md/llms.txt for the MCP tool set 404), and independent hands-on verification of the MCP tool behaviors is absent, leaning entirely on vendor marketing copy. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the MCP tools actually working as described, a published tool schema/OpenAPI-style reference, and confirmation of a distributable/installable MCP package rather than only a hosted agent.
